真正的机缘，承天小龙脉（真正的机缘，承天小龙脉（第22页）某个方向。一个英姿飒爽的女子，站在一棵大树枝丫处。看着下方和怪异生物大战的苍玄弟子。等苍玄外门弟子杀死怪异生物。一张血色符箓突然出现在他上空。数道血色锁链落下，将他缠绕。锁链勒进苍玄弟子的身体，饱满的血肉之躯。以一种极快的速度枯萎。锁链飞到女子身上，和她融为一体。女子眉心浮现一道血色纹路，气息强大不少。她转身看向某个方向，运转身法仙技，很快消失在原地。……外界。黑梧长生宗的女长老。笑着看向没了一只耳朵的顾城客和少了三根手指头的李大虎。“两位，再过十分钟，就算我把你们的耳朵和手指缝上，也会坏死，只能换新的。”顾城客冷眼看着李大虎，他的耳朵，被李大虎握在手里。李大虎的怒目圆睁，他少了三根手指头，断口光滑平整。他的手指头，在顾城客手里。两人的战斗早在几个小时前就已经结束了。但是，谁也不想先归还对方的身体部位。谁先归还，就是谁输。李大虎冷哼一声，“老家伙，算老子怕你了，把老子是手指头还给我。”顾城客冷笑一声，“你先把我的耳朵还给我。”李大虎用力将耳朵扔向顾城客。但是让几人没有想到的是，李大虎忘记了自己的力量有多大。一只耳朵怎么可能承受得了。在空中直接炸开。顾城客面色铁青，“畜生，我的耳朵，给我死啊！”……洞穴内。林罪将黑网拔起，黑网的根须很长，好像有生命一般，还想着攻击他，缠绕在他的身上。他释放仙力。桎梏剑意将根须搅碎。他看向黑网连接的中心点，那里，隐隐浸出猩红色的血液。龙吟声的来源，就是中心点之下。坐忘石释放的情绪愈发渴望。他一咬牙，催动。将黑网连根拔起，露出下面的东西。林罪微微一愣。世上，真的有龙。黑网之下，是一条由无数血色脉络形成的小龙。和前世神话之中的龙长得一模一样。长达一米。只是，它没有血肉之躯。它在空中疯狂挣扎，它的后背正中，是黑网走向的中心位置，连接在一起。黑网被林罪紧紧握在手里，它根本挣脱不开。只能发出痛苦的龙吟声。林罪心中只有一个想法，那就是吃了这条血色小龙。他肯定可以突破四骨人仙。他将血色小龙往他的方向拉。怕小龙挣脱黑网，他腾出右手，伸出手指。画出两张冰冻符，将血色小龙暂且冻住。他的符种能量，基本消耗了一半。将冰冻着的小龙拉近自己后，冰块裂开。血色小龙躺在地上，精力没有之前旺盛。黑网在缓缓枯萎。他一刀斩下黑网和血色小龙的连接位置。掐着血色小龙的脖颈，仔细打量着。和之前宴山的那头走蛟不同。近距离观看血色小龙，他的心中，愈发震撼。“我也不知道你叫什么名字。”“那我也给你取一个名字。”“就叫做。”……

The real opportunity, the Chengtian Little Dragon Vein (the real opportunity, the Chengtian Little Dragon Vein (page 22)) is in a certain direction. A heroic woman stood on the branch of a big tree. Looking down at the Cangxuan disciple who was fighting with the strange creature. Waiting for the Cangxuan outer disciple to kill the strange creature, a blood-colored talisman suddenly appeared above him. Several blood-colored chains fell and entangled him. The chains were inserted into the body of the Cangxuan disciple, full of flesh and blood. The body withered at an extremely fast speed. The chain flew to the woman's body and merged with her. A blood streak appeared on the woman's eyebrows, and her aura was much stronger. She turned to look in a certain direction, and quickly disappeared. The female elder of the Black Wu Changsheng Sect smiled and looked at Gu Chengke, who was missing three fingers. The seams between your ears and fingers will also become necrotic, so you can only replace them with new ones." Gu Chengke looked at Li Dahu coldly, and his ears were held in Li Dahu's hand. Li Dahu's eyes widened. He was missing three fingers, and the fractures were smooth and flat. His fingers were in Gu Chengke's hands. The battle between the two had ended a few hours ago. However, neither one wants to return the other's body parts first. Whoever returns them first will win. Lose. Li Dahu snorted, "Old guy, I'm afraid of you, give me your finger." Gu Chengke sneered, "Give me my ear first." Li Dahu threw the ear at Gu Chengke hard. But what they didn't expect was that Li Dahu couldn't bear it. It exploded in the air. "Beast, my ear." Duo, die! "...In the cave, Lin Zui pulled up the black net. The roots of the black net were very long, as if they were alive, and they were still trying to attack him and wrapped around his body. He released his immortal power and smashed the roots with his sword. He looked at the center point where the black net was connected, where scarlet blood was faintly leaching. The source of the dragon's roar was under the center point. The emotion released by Zuo Wangshi became more and more eager. He gritted his teeth and urged it. Uprooting the black net, revealing what was underneath. There really is a dragon in the world. Under the black net, it is exactly the same as the dragon in the previous life. It is just that it has no flesh and blood. It is struggling in the middle of the air, and is connected to the center of the black net. He couldn't get away. He could only let out a painful roar. He could definitely break through the four-bone human immortal by eating it. Fearing that the little dragon would break away from the black net, he stretched out his right hand and temporarily froze the little bloody dragon. The piece cracked. The blood dragon lay on the ground, not as energetic as before. He cut off the connection between the black net and the blood dragon, and looked at it carefully. Looking at the blood dragon at a close distance, he felt even more shocked. "I don't know what your name is." "Then I'll give you a name."
